bug_report:

[hjl@gnu-tgl-3 tmp]$ cat x.c
struct A { int a[6]; void *p[7]; };

int baz (int a, int b, int c, void *p, struct A s);

int
foo (int a, int b, int c, void *p, struct A s)
{
  return baz (a, b, c, p, s);
}
